record_notes:
Account summary
- MedOrbit Health = healthcare platform (care coordination + clinical workflow tooling). Exploring LLM features but strict PHI posture.
- Primary driver: ship summarization + semantic search without moving PHI outside customer-controlled environments. "On-prem first" preference, VPC acceptable for non-PHI / de-identified workloads.

Firmographics / org
- HQ: US (NA). Multi-tenant SaaS serving provider groups + some payer adjacencies.
- Stakeholders (known):
  - Security/GRC: security lead attended review (asked detailed logging + retention questions).
  - Platform Eng: owns Kubernetes + networking.
  - Product/ML: owns summarization feature + prompt sets.

Current stack (as described)
- Infra: Kubernetes (EKS for SaaS control plane); separate customer environments for larger customers.
- Data: Postgres + S3-compatible object storage; SIEM is Splunk in most environments.
- Identity: Okta for internal + some customer SSO flows.
- LLM today: mixed POCs (Azure OpenAI for non-PHI experiments; internal vLLM cluster for limited PHI sandbox). Pain = unpredictable latency under load + operational burden + unclear auditability story.

Use-cases / workloads
- Clinical note summarization (discharge summaries, visit recap) and inbox triage.
- Doc search over patient documents + care plans.
- Support-agent for internal clinical ops teams.
- Expectation: evaluate 1–2 workloads first; goal is to standardize inference runtime for production.

Non-negotiables (PHI / compliance)
- PHI handling: wants ability to keep PHI inside their controlled environment; on-prem package is strongly preferred for initial launch.
- BAAs / contractual: asked directly about BAA readiness and DPA terms (not committing yet; wants standard language + process).
- Data retention: explicit requirement for retention controls + ability to support "no prompt/output storage" modes.
- Audit logs: needs admin + inference event logging with export to Splunk (format + fields requested).
- Encryption: wants customer-managed keys option (KMS/HSM). Asked whether keys can stay in their HSM for on-prem.

Security review (Fireflies: ff_2026-01-16_medorbit_security_review)
- Topics covered:
  - SOC 2 posture and how evidence is shared (report + bridge letter under NDA).
  - Audit logging expectations: what events we log (authn/authz, config changes, model deployment changes, request metadata) vs what we do NOT log by default (full prompt/output unless configured).
  - Retention + residency: requested clarity on defaults, configurability, and whether any data leaves the environment in Private/on-prem mode.
  - Access controls: SSO/SAML, RBAC roles, break-glass admin process.
  - Incident response + support access: asked how Redwood engineers access systems in Private/on-prem and whether access can be customer-approved/time-bound.
- Notes from call (paraphrased): "We can’t have prompts or outputs stored in any vendor-controlled system. If we do store, we need explicit controls + export + delete SLAs."

POC intent / evaluation
- They are open to a 2–3 week technical evaluation if we can:
  - Confirm packaging + operational model for on-prem (upgrade cadence, monitoring, who patches what).
  - Provide a reference architecture + responsibilities matrix.
  - Demonstrate audit logging + export path into Splunk.
- Success criteria (early draft):
  - Latency: P95 < 1.5s for typical summarization request (target token sizes TBD); consistent performance under concurrency.
  - Reliability: clear fallback/routing story (model variant fallback acceptable if quality gates met).
  - Compliance: retention controls + auditable access with SSO/RBAC.

- 2026-01-08: Inbound via regulated workloads landing page (healthcare variant). Hannah qualified + routed to Fatima for regulated discovery.
- 2026-01-16: Security review call held (ff_2026-01-16_medorbit_security_review). Evidence packet requested.
- 2026-01-24: Follow-up email thread opened for questionnaire + NDA gating (see thread_20260201_medorbit_security_questionnaire).
- 2026-02-01: Security questionnaire exchange; asked for explicit retention statement + audit log samples. Support ticket SUP-3950 opened re: retention/audit log export configuration wording.

Action items / owners
- Redwood (Aisha/Olga/Kevin): assemble evidence packet list for release under NDA (SOC 2, subprocessor list, IR/BCP summary) + confirm what can be shared.
- Redwood (Fatima/Simran): run architecture workshop for Private/on-prem; walk through network boundaries, log pipeline, KMS/HSM integration points.

Open questions
